question: lit section 8 Q5: which atx-risk-v1.1 style columns carry no theme, and what share of the book's ex-ante variance sits on them alone? That share bounds what a DMRS-style hedge (theme-cov-hedge-v1, cell P9-H) can remove (lit section 8 Q5; plan section 2.4 AL-COMB (3); risk register 'DMRS does not translate').
when: root runs it between wave 2 and the P9 cells, before the PM registers P9-H; its numbers are printed in the P9 prereg (plan section 2.4 AL-COMB (3), wave2-carry AL-COMB)
ledger: none: no --ledger on any step, nothing appended to any trials ledger; descriptive only (v8-prereg rule 8, as book_diagnostics.py declares): it gates, selects and re-weights nothing
blind: reads the book's holdings (positions) and the risk model's ex-ante forecasts only; prints variance shares, never a realised return, IC, Sharpe, turnover or NAV number; nothing dated 2024-01-01 or later (the role and fields are the parent's TRAIN 2020-2023 inputs; book_diagnostics refuses sealed rows)

book.cell: the NAV cell of the parent P9-H will be registered on: the last accepted cell when root runs this (nominal: X-5, scripts/specs/v8/x-theme-erc.json, the nominal parent of scripts/specs/p9/templates/theme-cov-hedge.json); root names the cell and its resolved outputs ($N NAV dir, $ROLE role dir, $FIELDS fields dir) in integration-log.md before the run
book.holdings: $N-h: the cell's --emit-holdings output (f64). If the cell ran without it, re-run its exact NAV argv with --emit-holdings $N-h --output $N-hrun; every daily CSV, summary.json, recipe.json and v7_extras.json must equal the cell's byte for byte (holdings are an observer; task-G-report.md step 1, the B0c precedent in platform-v8 integration-log.md 'B0c diagnostics'); the re-run is not ledgered

risk_store.used: atx-risk-v1.1: the risk verb's output with --book-weights and --emit-exposures all (book_diagnostics.py G-2a reads its geometry: market, 50 industry slots, 11 styles)
risk_store.allowed: K-P9-12 lets either risk store serve; the COV store (atx-cov-v1, .atxcov) has no G-2a reader today (book_diagnostics.py reads only atx-risk-v1.1), so using it needs a reader first (not in AL-COMB's scope)

steps.note: the B0c argv form (about 36 s, 640 MiB on lo3); the bias harness's own book verdict is not read (G-2a reads the variance split)

steps.argv: "$PY" scripts/run_bounded_research.py --seconds 600 --max-rss-mib 2560 --min-free-mib 512 --output build-equity/p9-q5-g2a-run --bind atx-impl/tools/book_diagnostics.py -- "$PY" atx-impl/tools/book_diagnostics.py run --only G-2a --risk build-equity/p9-q5-risk --output build-equity/p9-q5-diagnostics/diagnostics-v8-g2a.json
steps.note: E-18's caps for a diagnostic step; schema atx.book-diagnostics/v1; every session must be complete (incomplete_sessions printed)

columns.source: atx-impl/tools/book_diagnostics.py RISK_STYLE_NAMES (atx-risk-v1.1) against the theme texts of atx-impl/strategies/alphas/registry.json (themes), read 2026-10-03 at 1239a5ff

no_theme.size: no theme ranks on market capitalisation
no_theme.residual_vol: no theme ranks on residual volatility (low_risk's scaled MAX and MAX5 are per unit of volatility, not volatility)
no_theme.liquidity: no theme ranks on a liquidity level (price_volume correlates dollar liquidity with volume, a time-series structure, not a level)

named_by_a_theme.beta: low_risk: QMJ safety (low beta) and betting against correlation

prints.primary: q = the sum over the no_theme columns (size, residual_vol, liquidity) of G-2a's style_share_of_summed_variance (Euler contributions x_k (F x)_k over the summed daily ex-ante variance; a column may be negative), with each column's own share beside it
prints.upper_bound: q_lit = the same sum over lit_upper_bound (adds beta and leverage, which low_risk names)
prints.context: G-2a's share_of_summed_variance (market, industry, style, specific), mean_share, mean_ex_ante_vol_annual, complete_sessions / incomplete_sessions, mean_uncovered_gross, by_year

reading.decides: nothing by itself: the PM rules P9-H's registration with q and q_lit printed in the prereg
reading.arithmetic: a hedge that removes at most a share q of the book's variance at unchanged alpha raises the Sharpe ratio by at most the factor 1 / sqrt(1 - q): q .02 -> 1.010, .05 -> 1.026, .10 -> 1.054, .20 -> 1.118, .34 -> 1.231. Lit section 1.1's +.05 to +.15 [est] needs about 1.03 to 1.09 at the book's Sharpe (1.77, the figure lit section 7 uses), i.e. q of about .05 to .15 removed; q (primary) well below .05 argues against registering P9-H, q_lit is the most the lit's own list allows
reading.caveat: DMRS's hedge removes each theme's unpriced loading on its own factor, which the style columns approximate only (lit section 7 'DMRS is the largest claim'); the bound is lit Q5's framing, recorded as stated, not a derivation

history.note: P9 lane AL-COMB deliverable (3); zero trials; written blind (no output of 2020-2023 read)
